text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, 
an email arrived on my work computer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
"Request for a Lecture on Umamusume 
Guidance"... 
Hm.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, forgive me. 
It happened to catch my eye.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Still, is this not wonderful? 
Your achievements have received the 
recognition they deserve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it appears the measures you 
devised regarding 
my "inverse body temperature" are 
especially commended...
choice_data_list:
You were the one who took the first 
countermeasures, Phalaeno.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet it was you who refined those 
countermeasures 
and elevated them into something truly 
effective.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...This calls for a celebration.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Humble though you may be, 
your efforts have borne fruit, and that is 
a joyous occasion.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
In honor of this milestone, 
allow me to present you with a gift.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Of course. 
Though I will require a little time to 
select it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now, will you leave the choice to me... 
or do you have a preference?
choice_data_list: I'll leave it up to you, Phalaeno.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ho, leaving it to me, are you? 
Understood. Then await it patiently.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A few days later. 
Phalaenopsis arrived carrying a paper bag.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Forgive the wait. 
Trainer, this is for you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It is a scented sachet. 
Open it and take in the fragrance within.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the box, I picked up the sachet. 
Amidst the crisp, dignified scent of 
cypress, 
the sweet fragrance of narcissus gently 
drifted through.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
A scented sachet serves both to sharpen 
one's focus 
and bring tranquility to the spirit.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Breathe deeply, as though walking through 
a serene forest. 
...May your lecture go splendidly.
choice_data_list:
...I'll make sure it's an absolute 
success!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, I noticed there was another box 
resting at the bottom of the paper bag.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that is a little extra. 
They are quite delicious manju, so please 
enjoy them.
choice_data_list: Thank you, I'll dig right in!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sweet bean paste was visible through 
the thin skin. 
Though dense and filling, 
its sweetness was refined and never 
cloying.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Those manju are truly exceptional when 
freshly made as well.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Once your lecture concludes successfully, 
I shall take you to that teahouse.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: For our true celebration, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I breathed in the scent of the sachet 
deeply once more. 
My posture straightened. My mind cleared.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Congratulations. 
May that fragrance be a source of support 
for you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Understood. 
Something practical, you say.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. It is decided. 
Wait here a moment.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Forgive the wait. 
—Tell me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Would you show me your planner?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As requested, I take out my planner from 
my coat pocket. 
It's the one I've been using ever since my 
days at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, it certainly has that well-worn 
charm.
choice_data_list:
I just haven't gotten around to replacing 
it...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
There is no need. 
—Here, lend it to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Phalaenopsis brought out was a 
planner cover 
adorned with moth orchids.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The brand-new cover wraps around the 
tattered exterior. 
In place of a bookmark, a moth orchid 
charm sways gently.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: There, that should do it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
That you have worn this planner down to 
such an extent 
is proof of nothing less than your 
tireless efforts.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yet it looked as though it might tear and 
fall apart at any moment, 
and I could not help but feel concerned.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it. 
'Tis merely a small token.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
With that planner in hand... 
continue to dedicate yourself, day by day.
